article.title: Hawks face the Cavaliers on 3-game skid
article.linkText: Hawks face the Cavaliers on 3-game skid
article.story: Cleveland Cavaliers (3-1, fifth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Atlanta Hawks (2-3, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Atlanta; Thursday, 8 p.m. EDT LINE: Hawks -1.5; over/under is 238.5 BOTTOM LINE: Atlanta heads into the matchup against Cleveland as losers of three in a row. Atlanta went 46-36 overall and 27-25 in Eastern Conference play a season ago. The Hawks averaged 30.1 assists per game on 43.6 made field goals last season. Cleveland went 52-30 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Cavaliers shot 48.2% from the field and 36.0% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot). Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Khalifa Diop: day to day (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
